newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Product Swaps - Jet/gasoil regrade widens.
newsitem.headline: Asia Product Swaps - Jet/gasoil regrade widens.

text.p: Firm jet demand has widened the March jet/gasoil spread to $2.50 per tonne, up from Wednesday $1.90, traders said on Thursday.
Singapore cash jet fuel jumped 40 cents higher on Wednesday after a trader purchased a 100,000-barrel lot from European major at $29.50 per barrel for March 20-24 lifting.
"The hike caused the regrade to widen," said a broker.
He said if the jet prices continues to firm, the spread would widened further.
At midday Thursday, April regrade was bid at $1.10 per barrel, unchanged from Wednesday.
March gas oil was quoted at $25.70/$25.95, little moved from Wednesday quotes. April was indicated at $24.50/$24.75.
On the crude futures, the April contract on SIMEX is being discussed at $19.33/$19.37, slightly below London's settlement of $19.40.
IPE gas oil futures was traded down $1.75 a tonne.
"Crude prices are not providing much of a direction to swaps prices," said another broker.
March fuel oil was quoted at $99/$100.75, steady from Wednesday quotes.
Traders said the cash market, currently assessed steady to shade firm, may help boost swaps levels.
But most players remained cautious, as a volatile market early this week, have pushed some players to the sidelined.
